d: From the icy waters of Alaska to mysterious lakes and remote Australian rivers, Jeremy Wade's Dark Waters S1 takes you on a journey into some of the most intriguing underwater mysteries. With angler and biologist Jeremy Wade, explore the search for a Giant Pacific halibut in Alaska, where the mystery of disappearing salmon matches the challenge of seeing how big a catch can get. Could an orca (killer whale) be responsible? As killer whales hunt salmon, Jeremy follows the clues to investigate what is happening beneath the surface. Elsewhere, the legendary monster of Lake Garda leads him…
